company_name.title: Company Name (Single)
company_name.description: Name of a single company to monitor. Leave blank if using the bulk CSV option.

companies_csv.title: Bulk Companies CSV
companies_csv.description: CSV content (or URL to a CSV file) with one company name per row, first column. Supports up to 20 companies. Overrides 'Company Name' if provided.

time_window.title: Time Window
time_window.description: How far back to look for news articles.

intent_categories.title: Intent Categories
intent_categories.description: Which event types to track and classify.

enumTitles: Expansion (organic growth, new markets, new offices)
Technology (AI, digital transformation, tech adoption, R&D)

custom_intent.title: Custom Intent / Search Term (optional)
custom_intent.description: Add a custom keyword or phrase to search for that is not covered by the Intent Categories above (e.g. 'sustainability', 'ESG', 'supply chain'). Leave blank to skip.

country.title: Country Filter (optional)
country.description: Restrict news to a specific country. Use a full country name or ISO code (e.g. 'United States', 'UK', 'Germany', 'IN'). Leave blank for global results.

max_results.title: Max Results (per company)
max_results.description: Maximum number of events to return per company.

min_impact_score.title: Minimum Impact Score
min_impact_score.description: Only return events with this impact score or higher (1–10).

groq_verify.title: Enable Groq Self-Verification
groq_verify.description: Run a second Groq LLM pass to verify summaries against source text (detects hallucinations). Increases API usage; recommended for high-accuracy runs.
